stem:
Mr. Martínez asked his students to write a situation that could describe the relationship between all the values of x and y in the table.

|   | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| x |   |   |   |   |
| y | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 |
instruction: Which situation best describes the relationship between all the values of x and y in the table?

options.label: A
options.text: Rachel had six dollars and then started to save one dollar each week.

options.label: B
options.text: Beatriz ran one mile the first week and one mile each week after that.

options.label: C
options.text: James read zero books in six months and then started to read one book each week.

options.label: D
options.text: Marion has six times the number of toy trains that Tony has.

visual_elements: table with x values 0,1,2,3 and y values 6,7,8,9
